newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisian UBCI bank has '96 higher profit.
newsitem.headline: Tunisian UBCI bank has '96 higher profit.

text.p: Tunisia's Union Bancaire pour le Commerce et l'Industrie UBCI net profits for 1996 amounted to 26.20 million dinars, up from 18.54 million dinars in 1995, provisional results showed on Wednesday.
Turnover in 1996 was 76.16 million dinars and balance sheet 748.39 million dinars.
The bank's capital and reserves totalled 96.23 million dinars at end of 1996.
UBCI is listed at the Tunis Stock Exchange where its share's price ranged between 66.1 dinars and 47.5 dinars in 1996. It was last priced 47.98 dinars.
BNP Intercontinentale is among UBCI's main shareholders.
